component.name: PaperNym
component.summary: Academic PDF renamer with scholarly metadata resolution

description.p: PaperNym is a desktop background utility and command-line tool that extracts DOIs, arXiv IDs, PMIDs, and titles from research PDFs, queries scholarly metadata APIs (Crossref, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Europe PMC, arXiv), and safely renames files according to customizable naming presets.
Key features include live download folder monitoring, drag-and-drop instant renaming, BibTeX citation export, collision prevention, and completely local SQLite history tracking.
Added Europe PMC provider, scanned PDF detection, drag-and-drop PDF renaming, and BibTeX citation export.
